TITLE 16 - BUILDINGS AND CONSTRUCTION
 
16.305 EXISTING BUILDING CODE
 
16.305.201.5
 
Section 201.5 of the International Existing Building Code is hereby added to read as follows:
(History: Ord. No. BC-3499, §55, 2026; Ord. No. BC-3286 §42, 2020)
16.305.201.5 Interpretations of definitions. For purposes of interpretation of the definitions of Existing 
Building and Existing Structure in Section 202, the phrase “a legal building permit” shall be interpreted to mean 
one for which a final certificate of occupancy has been issued.
